name: A Minecraft Server
description:
Server Information

Welcome to NOBLES MC, a semi-vanilla survival server for players who enjoy a relaxed, slow-paced Minecraft experience. Build, explore, gather resources, and make new friends. Both Java and Bedrock players are welcome!

Enjoy a classic survival experience with a balanced economy, player shops, custom features, ranks, and exciting rewards.

Take your time, create your own adventure, and enjoy Minecraft at your own pace.

No Rush, Just Enjoy the Game!

Java IP: noblesmc.xyz

Bedrock IP: noblesmc.xyz

Port: 18507
